caption: The drawing shows three kitchen objects arranged separately on a plain background. In the top left, there is a brass stand with a circular opening at the top, supported by three curved metal rods, and a central base with concentric rings. Attached to this base is a handle that extends horizontally and is shaded in a dark tone. To the right, there is a brass teapot with a round, bulbous body, a short spout, a domed lid topped with a spherical knob, and a handle arching over the top, which is made of wire with a dark, ridged grip in the center. At the bottom left are two small items: a small round container with a textured substance inside and a long, dark handle, and a matching spoon angled over the container, its bowl resting on the contents. All the objects are rendered in shades of yellow and brown with dark areas for shadow, suggesting metallic surfaces. The drawing employs light shading and crosshatching to create depth and highlight the reflective quality of the brass. The composition is organized with the Stand and Kettle occupying the upper part, and the container and spoon positioned below, with no visible background elements.
title: Burner and Kettle
